description: This file defines policies and a HostInfo structure for sandboxing processes in the Cuttlefish project, including function declarations for creating sandbox policies and managing host environment details.

classes.name: HostInfo
classes.description: Structure holding host environment paths and methods to ensure directories exist and retrieve executable paths.

methods.name: EnsureOutputDirectoriesExist
methods.description: Ensures that all output directories specified in HostInfo exist.

methods.name: HostToolExe
methods.description: Returns the path to a host tool executable given its name.

methods.name: EnvironmentsUdsDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for environment Unix Domain Sockets.

methods.name: InstanceUdsDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for instance Unix Domain Sockets.

methods.name: VsockDeviceDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for VSOCK devices.
